easy: Done by only one side, without the other side agreeing.

ex.en: My brother unilaterally changed the rules of our game.
ex.ko: 남동생이 일방적으로 우리 게임의 규칙을 바꿨다.

easy: Not done on purpose.

ex.en: Bumping into her was unintentional.
ex.ko: 그녀와 부딪친 것은 일부러 그런 게 아니었다.

easy: In large amounts; more than enough.

ex.en: The garden was abundantly full of tomatoes.
ex.ko: 정원에는 토마토가 풍성하게 열렸다.

easy: A feeling of great love and admiration.

ex.en: The puppy looked at the boy with adoration.
ex.ko: 강아지는 그 소년을 사랑스럽게 바라보았다.

easy: In a loving way.

ex.en: Grandma affectionately calls me her little pumpkin.
ex.ko: 할머니는 나를 다정하게 '우리 강아지'라고 부르신다.

easy: A state of great suffering.

ex.en: Hunger is a terrible affliction for many people.
ex.ko: 배고픔은 많은 사람에게 끔찍한 고통이다.

easy: To talk about something without saying it directly.

ex.en: Mom alluded to a surprise but would not tell us what it was.
ex.ko: 엄마는 깜짝 선물이 있다고 넌지시 말했지만 무엇인지는 알려 주지 않으셨다.

easy: A frame in a garden that climbing plants grow over, making a shady spot.

ex.en: We ate lunch under the rose bower.
ex.ko: 우리는 장미 덩굴 정자 아래에서 점심을 먹었다.

easy: A woman or girl who helps the bride at a wedding.

ex.en: My aunt asked me to be a bridesmaid at her wedding.
ex.ko: 이모가 결혼식에서 나에게 신부 들러리를 해 달라고 했다.

easy: To force someone to do something.

ex.en: The bully tried to coerce me into giving him my lunch.
ex.ko: 못된 아이가 내 점심을 내놓으라고 강요하려 했다.

easy: A person who secretly plans something with others, often something bad.

ex.en: The conspirators met at night to make their secret plan.
ex.ko: 공모자들은 비밀 계획을 짜려고 밤에 만났다.

easy: To secretly plan something together.

ex.en: My sisters conspired to throw me a surprise party.
ex.ko: 언니들이 나를 위해 깜짝 파티를 하려고 몰래 계획을 짰다.

easy: Like the way people talk in everyday conversation.

ex.en: She writes her letters in a friendly, conversational style.
ex.ko: 그녀는 다정한 대화체로 편지를 쓴다.

easy: Able to eat away or destroy things by chemical action.

ex.en: Strong acid is corrosive and can burn holes in metal.
ex.ko: 강한 산은 부식성이 있어서 금속에 구멍을 낼 수 있다.

easy: A strong chemical that eats away at things.

ex.en: Keep corrosives like drain cleaner away from little kids.
ex.ko: 배수구 세정제 같은 부식제는 어린아이들 손에 닿지 않게 하라.

easy: Music where two or more different tunes are played at the same time and fit together.

ex.en: The piece uses counterpoint, with two melodies weaving together.
ex.ko: 그 곡은 두 선율이 어우러지는 대위법을 쓴다.

easy: Not being brave.

ex.en: Running away from the problem was an act of cowardice.
ex.ko: 문제에서 도망친 것은 비겁한 행동이었다.

easy: A machine that crushes things.

ex.en: The rock crusher broke big stones into gravel.
ex.ko: 돌 분쇄기가 큰 돌을 자갈로 부수었다.

easy: A giant in Greek myths with one eye in the middle of its forehead.

ex.en: Odysseus tricked the Cyclops and escaped from its cave.
ex.ko: 오디세우스는 외눈박이 거인을 속이고 동굴에서 탈출했다.

easy: A black-and-gray bird in Europe and Asia that likes to take shiny things.

ex.en: A daw stole a shiny spoon from our picnic.
ex.ko: 갈까마귀가 우리 소풍에서 반짝이는 숟가락을 훔쳐 갔다.

easy: To make a train go off its tracks.

ex.en: A fallen tree derailed the train.
ex.ko: 쓰러진 나무 때문에 기차가 탈선했다.

easy: A herb with thin, feathery leaves used to flavor food, like pickles.

ex.en: Mom puts dill in the pickles.
ex.ko: 엄마는 피클에 딜을 넣으신다.

easy: To give out something in small amounts.

ex.en: The machine dispenses one gumball at a time.
ex.ko: 그 기계는 껌볼을 한 번에 하나씩 내준다.

easy: Being kept out of a contest because you broke a rule.

ex.en: Pushing another runner led to his disqualification.
ex.ko: 다른 선수를 밀어서 그는 실격되었다.

easy: Hard to understand; mysterious.

ex.en: The cat gave me an enigmatic look.
ex.ko: 고양이가 나를 알 수 없는 눈빛으로 바라보았다.

easy: In a way that is right and fair.

ex.en: The team played ethically and never cheated.
ex.ko: 그 팀은 윤리적으로 경기하며 절대 속임수를 쓰지 않았다.

easy: To breathe out.

ex.en: Exhale slowly as you lift the weight.
ex.ko: 무게를 들어 올릴 때 천천히 숨을 내쉬어라.

easy: When a tiny living thing splits into two to make more of itself.

ex.en: Bacteria multiply by fission, splitting in two.
ex.ko: 박테리아는 둘로 쪼개지는 분열로 수를 늘린다.

easy: Careful not to waste money or things.

ex.en: My frugal grandma saves every rubber band.
ex.ko: 검소한 할머니는 고무줄 하나까지 다 모아 두신다.

easy: In great numbers; lots and lots.

ex.en: The fair had games and prizes galore.
ex.ko: 박람회에는 게임과 상품이 잔뜩 있었다.

easy: The secret police of Nazi Germany, known for being cruel.

ex.en: Our history book explains how the Gestapo spied on people.
ex.ko: 우리 역사책은 게슈타포가 어떻게 사람들을 감시했는지 설명한다.

easy: A small flash of light.

ex.en: We saw a glimmer of light at the end of the tunnel.
ex.ko: 터널 끝에서 희미한 빛이 보였다.

easy: To shine with a soft, flickering light.

ex.en: The stars glimmered over the lake.
ex.ko: 호수 위로 별들이 반짝였다.

easy: A deep ditch made by running water.

ex.en: Rain rushed down the gully after the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 지나간 뒤 빗물이 도랑을 따라 세차게 흘러내렸다.

easy: A bed on wheels for moving sick or hurt people.

ex.en: The nurses pushed the gurney down the hall.
ex.ko: 간호사들이 바퀴 달린 들것을 밀고 복도를 지나갔다.

easy: A small rubber ball used to play the game of handball.

ex.en: He bounced the handball against the wall.
ex.ko: 그는 핸드볼 공을 벽에 튕겼다.

easy: A kind of red-brown cattle with a white face.

ex.en: The farmer raises Hereford cattle.
ex.ko: 그 농부는 헤리퍼드 소를 기른다.

easy: A person who takes long walks in nature for fun.

ex.en: The hikers stopped to rest by the waterfall.
ex.ko: 등산객들이 폭포 옆에서 잠시 쉬었다.

easy: A special picture that looks 3D when light shines on it.

ex.en: My new card has a shiny hologram on it.
ex.ko: 내 새 카드에는 반짝이는 홀로그램이 있다.

easy: Making electricity using the power of moving water.

ex.en: The dam has a hydroelectric power plant.
ex.ko: 그 댐에는 수력 발전소가 있다.

easy: The study of how the body fights germs and sickness.

ex.en: My aunt works in immunology and studies vaccines.
ex.ko: 이모는 면역학 분야에서 일하며 백신을 연구한다.

easy: A very hot oven used to bake clay pots or bricks.

ex.en: Our clay bowls were baked in the kiln.
ex.ko: 우리 진흙 그릇은 가마에서 구워졌다.

easy: A person from Latvia, a country in northern Europe.

ex.en: Our new neighbor is a Latvian who loves to bake.
ex.ko: 새 이웃은 빵 굽기를 좋아하는 라트비아 사람이다.

easy: From Latvia or having to do with its people or language.

ex.en: We learned a Latvian folk song in music class.
ex.ko: 우리는 음악 시간에 라트비아 민요를 배웠다.

easy: To hate something very much.

ex.en: I loathe cleaning my room.
ex.ko: 나는 방 청소가 정말 싫다.

easy: A long green insect that holds its front legs up like it is praying.

ex.en: A praying mantis sat very still on the leaf.
ex.ko: 사마귀가 나뭇잎 위에 꼼짝 않고 앉아 있었다.

easy: Around June 21, the longest day of the year.

ex.en: We stayed outside late on midsummer because it was light so long.
ex.ko: 하지에는 해가 오래 떠 있어서 우리는 늦게까지 밖에 있었다.

easy: A tiny unit of weight; one thousandth of a gram.

ex.en: This vitamin has 50 milligrams of vitamin C.
ex.ko: 이 비타민에는 비타민 C가 50밀리그램 들어 있다.

easy: Very important.

ex.en: Graduating was a momentous day for my sister.
ex.ko: 졸업식은 언니에게 아주 중요한 날이었다.

easy: The time just after the sun goes down.

ex.en: We got home before nightfall.
ex.ko: 우리는 해가 지기 전에 집에 도착했다.

easy: A person allowed by law to watch people sign papers and say the papers are real.

ex.en: Mom signed the papers in front of a notary.
ex.ko: 엄마는 공증인 앞에서 서류에 서명하셨다.

easy: The part of a baseball field far past the bases.

ex.en: He caught the fly ball in the outfield.
ex.ko: 그는 외야에서 뜬 공을 잡았다.

easy: A fenced area where racehorses are saddled and shown before a race.

ex.en: The horses walked around the paddock before the race.
ex.ko: 말들은 경주 전에 대기장을 돌았다.

easy: A sudden sharp feeling, like pain or sadness.

ex.en: I felt a pang of sadness when my friend moved away.
ex.ko: 친구가 이사 갔을 때 가슴이 찡하게 아팠다.

easy: Letting everyone take part.

ex.en: Our science museum has lots of participatory exhibits.
ex.ko: 우리 과학관에는 직접 참여하는 전시가 많다.

easy: Working by using air pressure.

ex.en: The worker used a pneumatic drill to break the sidewalk.
ex.ko: 일꾼이 압축 공기 드릴로 보도를 깨뜨렸다.

easy: A strong, man-made material used to make cloth and plastic.

ex.en: My soccer jersey is made of polyester.
ex.ko: 내 축구 유니폼은 폴리에스테르로 만들어졌다.

easy: In math, an expression made by adding up several terms, like x² + 3x + 2.

ex.en: Older students learn how to solve a polynomial.
ex.ko: 고학년 학생들은 다항식 푸는 법을 배운다.

easy: A warm, soft food made by boiling oats or grains in water or milk.

ex.en: Goldilocks tasted the bears' porridge.
ex.ko: 골디락스는 곰들의 죽을 맛보았다.

easy: A small dog with a flat, wrinkly face and a curly tail.

ex.en: Our neighbor's pug snores loudly.
ex.ko: 이웃집 퍼그는 시끄럽게 코를 곤다.
